text_block_list.text: One morning, while on the way to work—

"Ding-dong-dang... doooong! 
Ding-ding-dong! Waaay-yo☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Helios weather report hereee! Um, so 
today! Can you believe it?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's... gonna... RAAAAAIN~~—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: K-Kyahhhhhh?!
(SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—A totally wild downpour of candy, for 
sure!! Ayee, take some☆

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's raining candy like crazy! 
Ahaha, Helios is popping off again today~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, she's being noisy again... And 
here I was trying to focus on 
practice—huh?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
There's something written on this candy 
wrapper. "The more failing grades you get, 
the more aesthetic it is." ...Pfft, what 
even is this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotta get mega hyped with my personal 
proverbs, right?! Just riding the vibe~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Helios's Hyped-to-Heaven Week!" is 
officially in session! I'm gonna lift this 
whole school straight up to heaven, so 
let's go☆

Starting the very next day, a rowdy and 
fun-filled week brought to us by Daitaku 
Helios got underway—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time for pranks, nodda!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gonna make everything super colorful, 
nodda~!! Rawr rawr☆

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fugyaah?! Someone dumped something on— 
Gold leaf?! Did my fried rice just become 
divine?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My plain ice cream just turned into a 
mega-sized Pegasus parfait, though?! 
Helios is being a total goddess~!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We're totally gonna prank even more, 
nodda☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants some too! Make Turbo's kids 
meal into a grown-up meal with glitter and 
whipped cream~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Why don't you get glitter on your 
chicken breast and broccoli too?! It'll 
make eating way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, maybe I will.

And just like that, a whole rowdy week 
flew by—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Helios's Hyped-to-Heaven Week!" Thanks 
for hanging out, everybody~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, is it over already?! I was so hyped 
the whole week! By the way, how come the 
teachers didn't get mad at you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's all thanks to my bestie Pal-chin! 
She set up some conditions? Or whatever? 
And ne-go-ti-a-ted!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Helios... Hey. Coming to school was 
super fun this week. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No need to thank me, seriously?! For real!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to make some noise, right? 
I'm the one who hates being bored, right?! 
If anything, thank YOU guys☆

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, you're welcome. Just 
kidding... Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Casually pulling everyone into the fun and 
making them smile without even realizing 
it... Helios-san is truly an angel...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ojou! How was your week?! Did it make 
school fun for ya?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, everything was quite ordinary. Now, if 
you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Colder than ice—more like concrete?! Will 
I ever get to see Ojou's smile in my 
lifetime?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what about you~?! How was my 
Hyped-to-Heaven week!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Not enough for ya?! Guess we're rolling 
with the greedy special course then☆ First 
up, closet DJing! Here we go☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Can't be helped! For now, we gotta 
throw an after-party, no cap!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doto-pi, Win-cha, Digi-taso, and~ Of 
course Pal-chin too☆ Let's all go totally 
wild together~!
